model: Review document TF-IDF unigrams/bigrams + Logistic Regression
preprocessing: Shared sentiment_model normalization/tokenizer; HTML br tags replaced with whitespace before training.
inference_unit: Full extracted review document including its title; segments are explanatory only.
confidence_definition: max(binary positive probability, binary negative probability); not neutral probability or independently calibrated certainty
neutral_policy: Neutral is abstention/uncertainty, not a trained neutral label. Binary data cannot measure true neutral precision/recall/F1. Probabilities are logistic estimates, not guaranteed calibrated confidence.
evaluation_protocol: Deduplicate normalized reviews; remove test matches to train. Stratified 80/20 split of official train, seed 42. Fit features/classifier on train only; select C and uncertainty thresholds on validation only; evaluate once on official test. No refit.
limitations: Binary English movie reviews; no true neutral training class.
Validation review split is not movie-disjoint.
Movie-review benchmark accuracy does not establish news, webpage, or sarcasm accuracy.
Reported failing article was not added to training or threshold selection.
